criterion.purpose: one pre-registered visibility intervention: draw the F1 coverage band and its gap from wall_frame-45 so the parking task becomes visible before it becomes lethal; then replay the round20 protocol unchanged and compare F1 holdout against round20

intervention.change: the F1 preview band drawn by tools.rl.v373_telegraph.render_state_telegraph only
intervention.window: [wall_frame-45, wall_frame) logical frames; the lethal window stays [wall_frame, wall_frame+12)

style.note: the preview paints only playfield-background pixels, so bullets and the player sprite are never covered; the gap itself is left as a dark slot flanked by fixed edge markers

intervention.not_drawn: teacher target region, option, countdown, frame clock, future action, hit state, labels, and any F1 geometry outside [wall_frame-45, wall_frame)
intervention.physics: advance() and every collision rule are untouched: inside the preview window standing in the band is not a collision; the same action sequence must hit at the same frame as before
intervention.other_families: F2/F3 output must be byte-identical to the round20 renderer, which is asserted both by unit test and by comparing the stored round21 assets against round20 run/assets
intervention.unchanged: worlds, world parameters, R19 split, teacher module and teacher actions, labels, pixel packing (uint8, depth 3, [max(0,f-4),max(0,f-2),f]), training protocol, closed-loop runner

data.source: the unchanged round20 join of the R18 manifest with the frozen R19 split

train.use: the only events rendered, labelled, encoded or trained on

validation.use: read-only: never trained, never labelled, never encoded; closed loop only

data.teacher: TacticalTeacherV2, unmodified; its 80-action trajectory per train event must equal the frozen round20 rollout action list exactly (no replanning, no repair)
data.labels: round20 labels verbatim: action_positive = the one-hot of the route first action, action_valid = teacher_verified

render.visibility_rule: the preview is frozen by two digests per train event (telegraph frames, and the diff mask against the unchanged renderer) plus one combined digest; the unit test additionally asserts the preview survives the 224x192 area resize

training.precision: FP32 without AMP, autocast disabled, matmul TF32 False, cuDNN TF32 False, float32 matmul precision highest
training.protocol: tools.rl.v373_valid_curriculum.encode/train_all/Network reused verbatim, so every hyper-parameter and the initialization rule are round20 code, not a copy
training.initialization: a fresh seed reset per N1 construction; the same seed must produce a byte-identical initial head state in both arms and must equal the frozen round20 (and R16/R17) initial head state for that seed
training.selection: final step only: no early stopping, no validation-based selection, no tuning

evaluation.order: all six checkpoints written and SHA-frozen first; only then the six R18 baselines, then B0, then the six checkpoints, validation before train
evaluation.runner: tools.rl.v373_telegraph.run_event_rendered: a line-for-line copy of the frozen R11 run_event with one added renderer parameter; a unit test asserts that, called with render_state, it reproduces the frozen run_event exactly (same candidates, same first hit, same feasibility)
evaluation.physics: the environment is still touhou_rl.tactical_teacher_validation.advance; the telegraph is input pixels only
evaluation.b0: the frozen baseline policy logits on the identical telegraph renders; a reference, not a capability
evaluation.six_baselines: round20.six_baselines, i.e. the frozen R18 policies()/causal_loop()/outcome(); pixel-free, so they must equal round20 row for row
evaluation.metrics: per arm per seed per family feasible and survived, every event first hit, the action distribution and switch structure, and for F1 every event: whether the decision-time x had entered the gap, the canonical x at the last safe frame, and the direction of the first move
evaluation.comparison: round21 F1 validation feasible per seed minus the round20 recorded value for the same seed; improved = any seed strictly greater, unchanged = all equal, worse = any seed lower
evaluation.holdout_rule: if ANY of the six R18 baselines is feasible on ANY validation event then the R18 filter has failed on the holdout side: report it verbatim and withhold the learning conclusion
evaluation.reporting: per family F1/F2/F3, never only aggregated; n=3 seeds; F2 validation has one group; mirrors are not independent samples
evaluation.degeneracy: single_candidate and switches<=1 are counted, listed and reported, never dropped

claims.significance: none: 3 seeds, 7 validation groups, at most 14 independent geometries (F2 has 2 nearly identical); descriptive only
claims.gate: no formal gate opened, no deployable checkpoint produced, no game executed
claims.can_show: whether making an already-determined F1 danger visible before it becomes lethal changes the grouped-holdout closed loop of the identical distillation; and, if it does, that this is a visibility repair, not tactical understanding
claims.cannot_show: learnability of the other families, generalisation beyond 7 held-out geometries, or that a learned policy understands anything; a success here is evidence about the input, not the agent

criterion.failure_policy: first failure retained; one run; no retrain, rerun, repair of numbers, extra epoch, tuning or baseline switch

split.rule: one group = base + mirror, atomic; within each family the groups are ordered by group name (candidate index) and alternate train/validation starting with train at index 0; the two F2 groups therefore give one train and one validation group

physics.actions: constant hold (0), constant right (+2), constant left (-2), 80 decisions each

reference.f1_deaths: round20: 41/41 F1 deaths happen exactly on wall_frame, i.e. never inside the gap (P1-f1-visibility-round20.md, reconstructed by the subtask from the stored actions)

containment.actions: the round21 teacher action list must equal round20's stored actions
containment.labels: labels.pt and history.pt must be tensor-equal to round20's
containment.f2_f3: the stored depth-3 playfield stack must be array-equal to round20's
containment.f1: the same stack must be equal on every row outside the preview window and different on exactly the rows that contain a preview frame

initialization.method: fresh seed reset immediately before every N1 construction after the backbone load, through the unchanged r16/r20 code path

failure_policy: first failure retained; one run; no retrain, rerun, repair, overwrite, extra epoch or baseline switch
